Hi Priya,

Here’s a quick summary of the key Atlas figures:

• Launch dates – originally slated for 18 Nov, now moved to 2 Dec.
• Pricing – the Atlas Enterprise tier is priced at $48,000 per year.
• Discount floor – the lowest approved discount for Atlas is 22%.

Let me know if you need any further details.

Best,
Asha
